Commentary.Commentary: Australia need to bat well to chase this target and avoid a whitewash. Let's see what happens in the second half of the match.

Mennie came back again and broke the crucial partneship of the duo by sending Duminy back to the hut. The Australians bowled well in the slog overs and pulled the match back a bit. Miller and Phehlukwayo chipped in with handy knocks down the order and ensured their side crossed the 325-run mark.

The Aussies begun well as they took three wickets within 11 overs. The top order of the home side faltered as de Kock, Amla and du Plessis fell to loose shots. Mennie did the damage early on as he bagged a couple of wickets. Rossouw and Duminy joined hands and played really well to steady the ship. They stitched together a century partnership with Rossouw scoring a brilliant ton and Duminy scoring a breezy half century.

It has been a colourful display of stroke play from the Proteas and they hold the advantage at the moment as they have posted a big score of 327 on the board. They would be disappointed with the finish as they looked set to score around 340-350 but credit needs to be given to the visiting side for fighting back bravely in the slog overs.
DECENT FINISH FROM SA! Another full toss on stumps, Steyn heaves it through mid-wicket for a single. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 327/8!
A yorker on off, Rabada squirts it to covers for a single.
SIX! RABADA YOU BEAUTY! A length ball from Boland on middle, Rabada gets down and manages to get under it and swings it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a maximum. That was some shot by Rabada.
Low full toss on middle, Steyn heaves it through the on side for a single.

Four Byes! HARD LUCK! Fuller and on the stumps, Steyn gives himself room but misses it. The ball goes through him and beats Wade who is a bit messy and allows the ball through to the fine leg fence by four byes.
Too full outside off, Rabada drives it nicely to long off for a single.
FOUR! SLICED! Fuller outside off, Steyn manages to get under it and slices it over short third man for a boundary. That was well hit by Steyn. A handy boundary for South Africa.
Slower length ball that pitches and goes away, Steyn fails to put bat to ball, trying to give himself room.
Dale Steyn walks out to bat.

OUT! Is that out? Yes. A good length ball outside off, the change of pace, Abbot looks to dab it down to third man but gets an outside edge which carries to Wade. The players go up in an appeal. The umpire wants to check if it carried. The replays show it was clean as a whistle. Third wicket for Tremain and South Africa have lost their way a bit here.
Third umpire is referred for a caught behind appeal.
WIDE! Short ball on middle and off, Abbott lets it go through safely. A wide is signaled.
Kyle Abbott is the new man in for South Africa.

OUT! MILLER FALLS! Fuller outside off, Miller looks to go hard but ends up hitting it hard but straight to Smith at deep extra cover. Smith did not have to move an inch. A well planned dismissal, end of a good cameo from Miller.
Back of a length on off, Rabada takes a leg bye to third man. Miller will be on strike which is what South Africa would have wanted.
Back of a length on middle, pushed towards the off side by Rabada off his crease.
Full toss on the stumps. Rabada drives it down to long on for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Yorker from Boland and it works wonders, you wonder why would he not attempt these more? Yorker length on middle, Phehlukwayo fails to put bat to ball and has to go. Andile is not happy, he tried to squirt that one away but was beaten.
Very full outside off, Miller plays it to long off for a single.
FOUR! TOO EASY! This one is bowled on the pads, Miller gets in line and just works it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, driven down to long on for a single.
SIX! Welcome back, Mr. Boland! Length ball on middle, Phehlukwayo picks it and deposits it way over mid-wicket for a huge maximum. 300-up for South Africa!
Boland back on for his final spell.
Back of a length delivery on off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Slower length ball outside off, Miller punches it through covers and was looking for the second but has to settle for a single.
WIDE! Tries the back of the hand delivery again but sprays it wide outside off. A wide signaled.
Extra cover goes back for Miller now.
Length ball outside off, Miller crashes it through point for a couple of runs. That was bowled of the back of the hand by Tremain.
EDGED! Fuller length outside off, Miller throws his bat at it and gets an edge. Zampa comes across and does well at third man to keep it down to a couple of runs.
On a length on off, Phehlukwayo places it wide of short third man for a single.
Miller slices this one past Bailey at point for a single.
Flatter again on the stumps, driven down the ground for a single.
Flat on off, Phehlukwayo pushes it to mid off and takes off for a single. There was a run out chance but the fielder missed the stumps.
Pushed to mid on for a single by Miller.
Turns this one through mid on for a single.
Flatter on off, Andile keeps it out in time off his back foot.
This one is driven to covers by Phehlukwayo.
Good length on off, Miller dabs it down to short third man.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes out to bat.

OUT! Timely wicket for Australia! Slower one on off, Rossouw is again a bit too early into his shot and ends up skying it towards long on where Marsh takes the catch. End of a good knock from Rossouw and he walks off to a standing ovation. South Africa will be pleased with the form shown by Rossouw in the series.
A touch short on off, Miller pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short again on middle, Miller looks to dab it but gets a glove to it.
FOUR! FAR TOO EASY! Shorter length ball on the pads, Miller gets in line and pulls it wide of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. That also brings up the 50-run stand!
Rossouw and Miller are playing well and are looking dangerous.
Very full ball outside off, Miller dabs it down to third man for a couple.
Tremain comes back to bowl.
Flatter on the stumps, Rossouw drives it to covers but not for any runs.
Comes down and takes a single to the on side.
FOUR! SMASHED! Quicker one outside off, Miller lofts it over covers for a boundary. That was well hit.
Flatter again from Head, a single taken by Rossouw to deep point.
Works this one off his pads for a single.
Flatter on middle, Miller looks to drive but the ball goes off the inside half towards mid on for a couple.
Very full outside off, Rossouw just about gets his bat on that one. The ball goes wide of the point fielder but Rilee had connected well enough to rush back for the second.
Short again, going across off, Miller punches it to deep point for a single.
Another short ball from Marsh, Rilee plays it down to long on for a single.
Shorter length ball, Miller pulls this one through square leg for a single.
A length ball outside off, Miller has a swing at it and misses.
On a length on middle, Rilee looks to play it over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge to short fine for a single.
Mitchell Marsh comes back to bowl.
Rilee scoops this one over the head of the keeper for a run.
Miller works it through the on side for a single.
Turns this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle, Rossouw looks to work it through but misses. The ball goes off the pads for a couple of leg byes.
Shorter on off, Rilee goes back and punches it to covers but not in the gap.
Flatter on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Head comes back on for a bowl here.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! Short and going across off, Rossouw stays back and smashes it wide of the backward point fielder for a boundary.
LEADING EDGE! On a length on off, Miller looks to work it through the on side but ends up getting a leading edge down to third man for a single.
FOUR! NEATLY DONE! Length ball outside off, Miller gets across and guides it down to the third man fence. That was nicely done.
Tap and run! Length on middle, Rossouw taps it to the on side and takes a quick single.
Miller dabs this one to third man for a single.
Ohh! Touch short in length, Miller looks to pull it very fine but does not connect well. The ball goes off his pads and almost falls onto the stumps.
Length ball outside off, Rilee looks to smash it wide of covers but does not find the gap.
FOUR! POWERFUL! Shorter one on middle and leg, Rilee gets in position and pulls it through square leg. Head again lets the ball go through him.
The long on fielder goes a bit wide.
BEATEN! A length ball going across Rilee who comes down swinging at it but misses it completely.
DEFT! Shorter in length again, Rossouw waits for it and dabs it down to third man for a couple.
BOUNCER! A typical fast bowler's reaction. A short ball on the stumps but Rilee is out of the way in time.
FOUR! SMASHED! Good length on off, Rilee comes down a touch and gets on top of it and smashes it down the ground for a boundary. That went to the fence in a flash.
Good length on off, Miller defends it from his crease.
3rd ODI century for Rilee Rossouw.

CENTURY FOR RILEE ROSSOUW! Short ball on middle, Rilee gets on top of that one and pulls it to mid-wicket for a single to bring up his third ODI ton. He gets a warm applause from the crowd and he takes his time to soak in the applause. He will know he needs to carry on here.
Bouncer from Mennie, Rilee gets out of the way in time to let it go through.
Tucks this one through the on side for a single to get off the mark.
David Miller is the new man in. Can he do the damage here?

OUT! DUMINY DEPARTS! On a length outside off, Duminy is early into his shot and ends up hitting it straight to the fielder at point. Bailey takes a good catch. End of a good knock from Duminy. He would be disappointed with the fact that there was a hundred for the taking. A timely wicket for Australia, ending the 178-run stand and Mennie has his third.
This one is played down to long on for a single. Rilee is on 99 now.
Yet another slower ball, fuller length on middle, driven to mid off but not for any runs.
Another change of pace from Boland, Duminy works it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Shorter length again on middle, Duminy has ample time to get out of the way. The umpire signals it a wide for height.
On the pads, Rilee tucks it towards short fine for a single. That was bowled at 120.5 kph.
Length ball outside off, Rilee drives this one on the up but the ball falls short of the fielder at short cover.
GOOD BALL! Rilee comes down far too early, Boland spots it and bowls a shorter length ball outside off, Rossouw is beaten all ends up.
Starts off with a short ball outside off, Duminy places it wide of point for a single.
Boland is called back on for a spell. He has a good yorker and Australia will need a lot of those soon.
Length ball from Mennie which is dabbed down to third man for a single by Duminy to keep the strike.
Fuller in length on the stumps, pushed down to long off for a single.
On a length on middle, Rilee stands in his crease and defends it back down the wicket.
Driven down the ground for a single by JP.
This one is driven to mid off by Duminy.
FOUR LEG BYES! Fuller on the pads, Duminy fails to clip that away off his bat. The ball goes down to the fine leg fence after hitting the pads. The umpire signals it leg byes.
Joe Mennie back into the attack.
DRINKS BREAK!
Shorter length on off, Duminy pulls it wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Shorter length outside off, Rossouw leaps up as he plays the horizontal bat shot through covers for a single.
Bouncer! A short ball from Marsh which is left well by Rossouw.
Length ball outside off, Duminy dabs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rilee drives it nicely down to long off for a single.
FOUR! TONKED! Good length ball on the stumps, Rossouw picks it up  and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was asking to be hit. South Africa have attacked Marsh all day today.
Bouncer from Tremain, Duminy ducks under it easily.
Driven through mid off for a single by Rilee.
This one is bowled on a length on the pads, Rilee tucks it through square leg for a couple.
Shorter length on the stumps, Duminy is not quite in the right position but still plays the pull shot for a single to square leg.

FOUR! Oh dear, poor work from Mennie! Pitched up on off, Duminy times his drive towards mid off. The ball goes through Mennie, who is a touch late to bend down and that misfield results in a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller in length on middle, Duminy comes down the wicket and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was well picked by JP.
On a length on off, punched towards the off side by Rilee.
Good length on middle, played back to the bowler.
FOUR! SMASHED! Back of a length ball outside off, Rossouw slinks down the wicket and smashes it down the ground for a boundary. That was superbly hit.
Good length outside off, Duminy stands in his crease and guides it down to third man for a single.
On a length on middle, turned towards the on side.
Good length on off, played through covers for a single by Rossouw.
Full toss on the stumps, Duminy fails to put it away as he finds the fielder at mid on. A good over for Australia this.
Full again, comes in a touch, Rilee works it through the square leg region for a single. The bat turned in his hand there.
On a length on middle, Rilee looks to give himself room but ends up pushing it towards covers. Four dot balls in a row!
Fuller in length on off, comes in a touch, Rilee mistimes his defensive shot.
GOOD BALL! An attempted yorker from Tremain on middle stump, Rilee keeps it out. That was well kept out.
Good length on off, defended back down the wicket by Rilee.
Tremain is called back on.
Similar length on off, Duminy pushes it towards the off side.
Fuller length on off, Duminy comes forward and drives it to covers but not in the gap.
On a length on off, Duminy comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Punched down the ground for a single by Rossouw. The two batsmen are looking at ease here, Australia need to strike back.
Duminy plays this one past point for a single.
Good length on off, Duminy stands tall and defends it.
Marsh is back on for a bowl.
Rossouw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter on off, Rilee looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Touch short on off, Duminy goes back and punches it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Fuller on middle, Duminy gets down on it and sweeps it hard to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Drives this one through mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, played through the off side for a single. This is now the highest fourth wicket stand in ODIs for South Africa against Australia!
Shorter in length, Duminy goes back and plays it through mid on for a single.
Floated on off, Duminy mistimes his drive towards covers.
Duminy keeps this one out off his pads.
Drama! Rossouw looks to reverse but finds the length is not there and ends up driving this one through mid off for a single.
Full again on the stumps, Rossouw keeps it out.
24th ODI fifty for Duminy.
Fuller on middle, Duminy drives it through mid on for a single. That brings up his fifty, his 24th one. He will want to carry on.
Played to the point region by Duminy for a single.
WIDE! This one is bowled down the leg side, Duminy cannot clip that one. A wide is signaled.
Driven through covers for a single.
Duminy turns it through the on side for a single.
Shorter on middle, Rossouw goes back and works it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on the pads, turned towards mid-wicket but not for any runs.
Floated on middle, Duminy takes a single.
Travis Head comes into the attack.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Rossouw looks to go for a slog down the ground but mistimes it towards long on for a couple.
Tossed up on a length around leg, Duminy camps back and pulls it down to long on for a single.
A tad short on this occasion, hit hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, Duminy goes back and cuts it wide of third man for a single.
Bowled this very full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Floated on off and middle, Rilee comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
This one is guided to short third man but not for any run.
WIDE! Another short delivery but this one is not directed well and a wide results as Duminy fails to put bat to ball.
Short again on the body, Duminy hops as he attempts to keep that one down and plays it wide of the fielder at deep fine leg for a couple.
Good length outside off, Rossouw punches it on the up towards covers for a single.
A length ball on middle and leg, Rossouw is early and too eager to smash that one, ends up toe-ending it towards mid on.
Short ball from Mennie that does not quite threaten Duminy much. Duminy pulls it in control through square leg for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Rossouw plays it through covers for a single.
Short but on the pads, Rossouw taps it towards square leg and Rossouw gets across in time to complete the single.
Flatter one on the pads, Duminy works it towards mid-wicket and calls Rilee through for a run.
Rossouw turns this one through mid on for a single.
SIX! Flighted but ends up as a full toss, Rossouw gets under it and smashes it way over mid-wicket for a maximum.
This one is on the stumps, Rossouw defends it back.
Flatter again on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
100 partneship up between Duminy and Rossouw.
WIDE! Flatter down the leg side, the batsman fails to clip it through. A wide is signaled.
Fuller on off, played through mid off for a single.
A single taken by Rossouw towards the off side.
FOUR! Good length outside off, Rossouw places it wide of the point fielder for a boundary. There was no stopping that one.
Turns it through the on side for a single.
Fuller length outside off, Duminy comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Good length on middle, Duminy comes down the wicket and looks to go big but does not connect well. The ball lands well short of the boundary rope, a couple taken.
Short again outside off, Rossouw rocks back and places it wide of the sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Flatter on the pads, Duminy turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Duminy defends it from his crease.
Full on middle, turned through the on side but not for any runs.
FOUR! CRASHED! Shorter length outside off, Duminy cuts it powerfully past point for a boundary. That was superbly hit.
Bowled on the stumps, Duminy comes down and takes this one on the full and clips it wide of mid on for a couple.
Good length on off, Duminy takes a single with a dab towards third man.
Shortish outside off, Rossouw just stays in his crease and looks to smash it but gets an edge which flies down to third man. The ball falls well short of the fielder. A single taken.
Fuller in length on middle, turned through the on side.
Good length on middle, Rossouw plays besides the line and dabs it towards short third man.
FOUR! TONKED! Shorter in length on middle and leg, Rossouw gets in line and just hammers it through square leg for a boundary.
Good length on middle, turned through the on side for a single.
This one is bowled on the pads, Duminy goes back and turns it towards the on side for a single.
Floated one on middle, played back to the bowler.
8th ODI fifty for Rossouw.
Well played, Rossouw! Flatter on the pads, Rossouw turns this one through the on side for a single and gets to a vital fifty.
Duminy too comes down the wicket and clips it wide of mid on for a single.
Almost! Just took a ball for Rossouw to go after Zampa! Rilee looks to come down and play the big shot, he ends up slicing it over point for a single.
Floated on middle, Rilee comes forward and defends it.
ADAM ZAMPA comes into the attack.
On a length on the pads, tucked towards the on side off the crease.
Another one, on 124 kph on middle and leg, Rossouw is beaten on his shot and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Tries the slower one, bowls it on the pads, Rossouw turns it towards the on side.
Good length on off, Rossouw defends it to the off side.
On the stumps, Duminy comes down and pushes it to the off side for a single.
On a length on middle, turned through the on side for a single.
Chris Tremain comes back on for a bowl.
Fullish around off, Rossouw plays it with soft hands towards the off side for a brisk single.
FOUR! That's cracked! A tad shorter and flatter outside off, Rilee rocks back and cuts it fiercely through the covers for a superb boundary.
Floated up on middle, Rossouw strides forward and defends confidently.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and wide outside off, Rilee drives it nicely towards deep cover for a couple.
FOUR! That's exquisite! Tossed up around off, Rilee drives it beautifully and beats short cover and the ball races to the boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Better over from Marsh this one.
Fullish ball around off, Duminy drives it sweetly through the covers for a couple.
Fullish delivery, Rilee lunges forward and drills it to long off for a single.
Duminy loves to drive on the up but only manages to get a bottom edge towards the keeper. He hurls in a throw at the striker's end but Duminy is safely in.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
On a length angling into Rilee. He comes forward and defends it nicely.
Rossouw drives it through mid on for a single.
50-partnership up for Duminy and Rossouw.
Fullish outside off, Duminy plays with soft hands towards point and comes through for a brisk single.
Wide. Going down leg, Duminy attempts to paddle it but fails to connect. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Tossed up on off, driven towards the covers.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Rilee opens the face of the bat and glides it towards the fielder at point.
Tossed up on a length outside off, Rilee waits for it and cuts it towards point.
DRINKS BREAK!
On a length on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! SMASHED IT! Fuller length on the stumps, Rilee slinks down the wicket and clobbers it flat and over long on for a maximum. They are not allowing Marsh to settle into a rhythm here.
Fuller length on off, Rilee pushes it through covers.
On a length on middle and leg, Rilee defends it back down the wicket.
On a length on off, pushed into the off side for a single.
On a length outside off, Rossouw looks to smash it through covers but does not connect well yet gets a single.
This one is on the stumps, Duminy defends it back.
Rossouw turns this one through the on side for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Rossouw fails to clip it through.
Flighted on middle, driven through mid off for a single.
Floated on middle, Duminy defends it back to the bowler.
Turns this one through the on side for a single.
WIDE! This one is bowled down the leg side, left alone. A wide signaled.
Time for some spin! Travis Head is the new bowler.
Good length on off, defended it down the wicket.
FOUR! SMASHED! Short ball from Mennie, Duminy gets in a good position and hooks it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Good length on off, pushes it towards covers but not for any runs.
This one is the pads but Duminy is happy to defend it back down the wicket.
On a good length on middle, Duminy covers the line and defends it back down the wicket.
Good length on off, goes away with the angle, left alone by Duminy.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Fuller in length on off, Rossouw smashes it down the ground for a boundary. Expensive over that for Australia, 17 runs from it.
Ah! Another misfield, this time from Zampa! A single taken with a push to cover where the fielders misfield.
FOUR! This has been a poor over! Full toss from Marsh which is drilled past the point fielder for a boundary. Plenty of boundaries already.
FOUR! Fullish outside off, Duminy gets across and pushes it towards covers. The ball goes wide of the two fielders who dive at short cover, covers and goes through for a boundary.
On a length on off, driven towards covers.
FOUR! Welcome Mr. Marsh! On a fuller length outside off, no half measures from Duminy as he flays it through the covers for a boundary.
Mitchell Marsh comes on to bowl.
Fuller length on off, Rilee mistimes his drive towards mid on but not for any runs.
On  a length on off, Rilee comes forward and pushes it to the off side.
Rossouw turns this one towards the on side but not in the gap.
FOUR! BEAUTY! On a fuller length on off, Rilee just presents the full face of the bat and the ball races down the ground for a boundary. That was superbly done by the southpaw.
On a length outside off, Rilee gets across and clips it to mid-wicket off his crease.
FOUR! Another drive! Fuller length outside off, Rilee gets forward and pushes it wide of mid off for a sublime boundary.
Good length on stumps, turned to the on side for a single.
Length ball on off, Rilee defends it down the ground but off the inside half of the bat.
Good length on off, worked through the on side but not for any runs.
On a length on off, Rossouw pushes it down the wicket.
Good length outside off, defended towards the off side.
FOUR! That's poor from Head! Fuller in length outside off, Rilee gets down on it  and smashes it to covers. Head at covers does not stop that one and lets it through for a boundary.
JP Duminy is the new man in for South Africa.

OUT! SA are not learning! On a length outside off, comes in with the angle, du Plessis looks to hoick it over the on side but misses and hears the death rattle. All the dismissals so far have been the result of the batsmen trying extravagant shots. Australia will not mind though, a couple of wickets already for Mennie.
On a length on off, defended towards the off side.
Too full on the stumps, du Plessis just about manages to keep it out.
Fullish outside off, du Plessis mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Good length on off, du Plessis defends it from his crease.
On a length on middle, played back down the wicket by du Plessis.
Fuller length outside off, Rossouw drives it on the up towards covers but not in the gap. End of an eventful Powerplay.
On a length on the stumps, Rossouw comes down to play that one but is beaten and ends up pushing back down the wicket.
This one is played towards point for a single by du Plessis.
Fuller length outside off, du Plessis looks to play on the up but finds the fielder.
Good length outside off, du Plessis pushes it towards the off side and screams "no".
FOUR! THUMPED! On a length on off, du Plessis covers the line and smashes it down the ground for a boundary. There have been quite a few of those today.
FOUR! Well done! On a length on off, Rossouw goes hard at this one and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
Fuller length outside off, Rilee gets across and turns it towards mid on but not in the gap.
This one is played wide of the point fielder for a single by du Plessis.
Fuller in length on off, du Plessis punches it towards mid off but not in the gap.
On a length outside off, goes away a touch, du Plessis feels for it and hangs his bat out for it but is beaten.
Good length outside off, du Plessis opens the face of the bat and  pushes it to the off side.
Fuller length outside off, Rilee drives it through covers but not in the gap.
Good length on off, Rossouw comes forward and defends it.
BEATEN! On a length outside off, Rossouw looks to play at it but is beaten and is late in pulling out of that one. No harms done though.
du Plessis takes a quick single with a nudge to the on side.
FOUR! OFF THE MARK! Fuller length outside off, du Plessis thumps it down the ground for a boundary. The ball raced away past mid on, the captain gets off the mark in fine fashion.
Good leave? On a length outside off, comes in late but du Plessis is happy to shoulders his arms to it. Can call it a good leave but it did come close to the stumps there.
Fuller length on the stumps, Rilee is right forward and defends it. That was a wicket maiden from Mennie.
On a length on off, Rossouw gets in line and defends it.
RILEE ROSSOUW comes in to bat at no 4.

OUT! BEAUTY FROM MENNIE! Fuller in length on off, Amla looks to play one more of his uppish drives. The ball beats him and cannons into the off stump. Two big wickets for Australia and in quick time. The bowling change has worked wonders for Australia, Amla was looking dangerous but he is taken care of and Australia will want to test the middle order of South Africa again.
On a length on middle, Amla is right forward in his defense.
On a length but down the leg side, Amla fails to clip that one. Wade goes up in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
This one is bowled on a length on middle and leg, Amla keeps it out.
Joe Mennie is the new bowler.
FAF DU PLESSIS is the new man in.

OUT! BOLAND STRIKES! Fuller in length outside off, de Kock is early into his drive and finds the fielder at short cover. Mitchell Marsh takes the catch and Australia have taken a vital wicket here. de Kock had not faced too many balls and didn't quite look in best of forms. A sign of things to come in terms of the slowness of the pitch?
On a length on off, de Kock works it towards the on side and looks for a single but it is not on.
Pitched up outside off, de Kock mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Uppish but safe! Full ball from Boland and Amla is too early into his drive. The ball falls short of the mid on fielder and they take a single.
FOUR! SWEET! Fuller length on off, Amla gets forward and opens the face of the bat and caresses it square through covers for a boundary.
Fuller length on off, turned through the on side for another single. There is no pressure on the South African openers for now.
Length ball on middle, de Kock turns it through square leg for another single. The Australians have not quite got their lines right yet.
Shorter length outside off, Amla pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Amla drives on the up again but Finch covers it well from mid off and stops. No runs taken.
On a good length on off, de Kock turns it towards square leg for a run.
On a length on off, Amla works it through the on side for a single.
FOUR! Too good! Amla is not missing out on these boundary balls. Very full outside off, Amla just stands in his crease and drives it on the up and wide of mid off for a boundary.
Fuller again on the stumps, de Kock fails to clip this one. Boland goes up in half-an appeal but realizes in time that the ball pitched outside leg and aborts his appeal.
Fuller in length on off, de Kock looks to clip but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
This one is bowled outside off, on a length, de Kock is opened up a touch but manages to defend it.
Length ball outside off, Amla taps it to the off side and takes a quick single.
FOUR! GORGEOUS! On a length outside off, the quick hands from Amla are in play as he just flays it through the covers for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, de Kock works it to deep square leg for a single.
Another nicely timed drive but not in the gap! Amla gets forward to this full ball outside off and drives it sweetly but to the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, de Kock looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat towards the on side for a single.
Amla turns this one through the on side for a single. That was a length ball again from Tremain.
FOUR! Well timed! Good length on the stumps, Amla whips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. That raced away to the fence. Amla has looked in good touch so far.
Very full outside off, Amla just stands tall and caresses it towards mid off. That was nicely timed but not in the gap.
Nicely done! Fuller in length on middle, de Kock leans across and clips it wide of mid on. Aaron Finch gives chase from mid on and slides to keep the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Back to the length delivery on off, Amla gets forward and defends it taking the bottom hand off on that one.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Slightly short outside off again, Amla stands tall and punches it wide of the point fielder for a superb boundary. That was brilliantly timed and pleasing on the eyes.
Good length on off, that keeps a touch low, Amla is watchful as he turns it towards mid-wicket off his crease. He has a look at the area where the ball pitched.
Oh! Short and wide outside off, Amla throws his bat at it from his crease but fails to connect. That was there to be hit.
On a length outside off, Amla mistimes his punch back down the wicket. The wicket seems to be on the slower side here.
On a length from Boland, a run taken with a deflection to the on side by de Kock.
Scott Boland to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On a length on off, Amla gets across and defends it back down the wicket. Good start for Tremain.
On a length outside off, de Kock works it toward mid-wicket off his crease and takes a quick single.
In the right area now, full in length outside off, de Kock presses forward and defends it.
On the pads from Tremain, de Kock does not miss out and clips it wide of the fielder at mid on for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Keeps it full outside off, de Kock is beaten a touch yet defends it back solidly. That was a slower one from Tremain.
Fuller in length outside off, de Kock comes forward and defends it nicely.
Game time! The two South African openers come out to bat. HASHIM AMLA and QUINTON De KOCK will want to begin well.  Australia begin with Chris Tremain. Here we go....
South Africa - Quinton de Kock(wk), Hashim Amla, Faf du Plessis(c), Rilee Rossouw, Jean-Paul Duminy, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Kyle Abbott, Dale Steyn, Imran Tahir.
Australia -  David Warner, Aaron Finch, Steven Smith(c), George Bailey, Mitchell Marsh, Travis Head, Matthew Wade(wk), Adam Zampa, Joe Mennie, Chris Tremain, Scott Boland.

TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and elected to bat first. Plenty of changes for South Africa. David Miller. Kagiso Rabada, Dale Steyn and Imran Tahir come in for Tabraiz Shamsi, Farhaan Behardien, Aaron Phangiso and Dwaine Pretorius. Australia replace John Hastings with Joe Mennie. We will have the playing XIs for you in a bit.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the fifth One-Day International between South Africa and Australia from Newlands, Cape Town. The tour has been nothing short of a nightmare for the visitors, they have suffered big losses and the only game they sniffed a win, they ran into a freak performance from David Miller. They will want to salvage some pride and return home with a win under their belt. South Africa on the other hand, will want to ensure they continue their domination and inflict a whitewash. Australia have never lost all the matches in a 5-match ODI series and the visitors have enough motivation to put in a clinical performance.
